# Applying Tidy Finance with Python to Vietnam

> An open-source, code-first guide by Mike Nguyen to empirical finance on Vietnamese market data with Python: portfolio sorts, factor models, asset pricing tests, valuation, and machine learning. The online edition is at https://mikenguyen13.github.io/tidy_finance_vn/; a Vietnamese edition is at https://mikenguyen13.github.io/tidy_finance_vn_vi/.

The book is an independent derivative work inspired by Tidy Finance (Scheuch, Voigt, Weiss, and Frey; https://www.tidy-finance.org/) and is not affiliated with its authors.

- Author: Mike Nguyen, https://mikenguyen.netlify.app
- Repository: https://github.com/mikenguyen13/tidy_finance_vn

## Research Methods Library (MCP server)

- [MCP endpoint](https://research-methods-mcp.vercel.app/mcp): Model Context Protocol server (streamable HTTP, no authentication) that indexes this book together with the author's other books, the causalverse R package, and research articles. Its tools recommend study designs with their identifying assumptions (`choose_method`), search and read sections (`search`, `fetch`), return runnable R and Python code (`get_code`), and format citations (`cite`); every result links to the section consulted.
- [Research Methods Library](https://research-methods-mcp.vercel.app/): setup instructions for Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT, Cursor, Visual Studio Code, and other MCP clients.

## Front matter

- [Preface](https://mikenguyen13.github.io/tidy_finance_vn/): attribution, motivation, data access, and structure of the book; use of the book in AI assistants
